sources.title: Bitcoin price in USD (CoinGecko)
sources.notes: Keyless public tier is rate-limited (~10-30 req/min) and returns 429 when tripped; keep the cadence at 5 minutes or slower. Response shape is {"bitcoin":{"usd":<number>}} which drives the fixed extract path.

spec_template.title: Bitcoin (USD)
spec_template.goal: show the current price of one bitcoin in US dollars

sources.title: Open-Meteo current weather
sources.notes: Keyless JSON weather; latitude/longitude in decimal degrees. Response carries a top-level current.{temperature_2m, wind_speed_10m} object driven by the URL's current= parameter.

spec_template.title: Weather
spec_template.goal: show the current temperature and wind speed at a location

sources.title: wttr.in current weather (JSON)
sources.notes: Keyless plain-language weather; format=j1 returns JSON. Community-run and occasionally rate-limits or blocks on burst; keep the cadence gentle (10+ minutes). temp_C is a stringified number in the response.

spec_template.title: Weather (wttr)
spec_template.goal: show the current conditions for a location via wttr.in

sources.title: USD to EUR exchange rate (Frankfurter / ECB)
sources.notes: Keyless daily FX rates published by the ECB (weekdays only, no weekend/holiday update). Response is {"base":"USD","date":"YYYY-MM-DD","rates":{"EUR":<number>}}. Upstream moved to api.frankfurter.dev/v1 (301 from frankfurter.app, found by the live prover 2026-09-21).

spec_template.title: USD → EUR
spec_template.goal: show the current USD to EUR exchange rate (ECB daily)

sources.title: USGS earthquakes (past day, magnitude 2.5+)
sources.notes: Keyless GeoJSON feed refreshed every ~5 minutes. Response is a FeatureCollection with metadata.count and features[].properties.{mag, place, time}. The recipe surfaces the count plus the first feature's magnitude and place.

spec_template.title: Recent quakes (M2.5+, 24h)
spec_template.goal: show how many magnitude-2.5+ earthquakes happened in the past day and where the top one was

sources.title: Stock quote (Finnhub)
sources.notes: Requires a free Finnhub API key entered as the api_key credential AFTER creation (the token rides the X-Finnhub-Token header via $secret, never the URL). Response is flat: {"c":<current>,"h":<high>,"l":<low>,"o":<open>,"pc":<prev close>,...}. Chosen over Alphavantage because Alphavantage's GLOBAL_QUOTE payload keys contain spaces ("Global Quote", "05. price") which the §4.1 path grammar cannot address.

spec_template.title: Stock quote
spec_template.goal: show the current price and previous close for a stock symbol

sources.title: Hacker News front page
sources.notes: Keyless Algolia search API over Hacker News. front_page tag returns the current front page as hits[] with title/url/points.

spec_template.title: Hacker News front page
spec_template.goal: show the current Hacker News front-page stories
